abstract: STUDY OBJECTIVE: To report surgical and pathologic outcomes after single-port laparoscopy (SPL) for adnexal masses in patients referred to a gynecologic oncology practice at a single academic institution. DESIGN: A retrospective analysis (Canadian Task Force Classification II.2). SETTING: A single academic institution with multiple hospital centers. PATIENTS: Women who underwent at least 1 single-port laparoscopic surgery for the treatment of an adnexal mass from 2009 to 2015 after referral to a gynecologic oncology practice. INTERVENTION: Data were collected on the surgical procedure, patient demographic variables, 30-day surgical outcomes, and hernia development. MEASUREMENTS AND MAIN RESULTS: Three hundred twenty-five surgeries were performed in 322 patients with a median follow-up of 42.7 months. The median age was 54.5 years, and the median body mass index was 28.1 kg/m(2). All patients underwent unilateral or bilateral salpingectomy or oophorectomy with or without hysterectomy (26.5%). The median operative time was 90.0 minutes. The median mass dimension was 6.4 cm with 17.9% (n = 60) greater than 10 cm. Masses were categorized as simple (11.4%) and complex (69.5%). Although the majority (87.4%) of masses were benign, 7.4% were malignant, and 5.2% were borderline. Benign masses were physiologic (16.6%), serous cystadenomas (19.1%), mucinous cystadenomas (6.8%), endometriomas (12.3%), myomas (12.3%), and mature teratomas (9.2%). In malignant cases (7.4%), serous carcinoma was the most frequent histology (58.3%). The rate of adverse outcomes within 30 days, including reoperation (0.0%), intraoperative injury (1.5%), venous thromboembolism (0.3%), and transfusion (0.6%), was low. The development of incisional cellulitis was 4.6%. The rate of incisional hernia was 4.0%, with a median occurrence of 18.3 months. Diabetes mellitus (p = .03) and obesity (p = .04) were significant predictors for a hernia, but mass complexity (p = .28), American Society of Anesthesiologists class (p = .83), and smoking (p = .82) were not. CONCLUSION: In patients undergoing SPL for the removal of adnexal masses in a gynecologic oncology practice, the rate of benign disease is high. SPL removal of adnexal masses is feasible and safe with favorable surgical outcomes, rare short-term adverse outcomes, and a low incisional hernia rate.
abstract_ja: 目的:単一の学術施設の婦人科腫瘍診療に紹介された患者において、付属器腫瘤に対する単孔式腹腔鏡手術(SPL)後の手術および病理学的成績を報告する。デザイン:後方視的解析(カナダ・タスクフォース分類II.2)。施設:複数の病院施設を有する単一の学術機関。対象:2009年から2015年の間に、婦人科腫瘍診療への紹介後、付属器腫瘤の治療のために少なくとも1回単孔式腹腔鏡手術を受けた女性。介入:手術内容、患者の人口統計学的変数、30日以内の手術成績、ヘルニア発生に関するデータを収集した。測定および主な結果:322例に対して325件の手術が施行され、追跡期間の中央値は42.7か月であった。年齢中央値は54.5歳、BMI中央値は28.1kg/m²であった。全患者が片側または両側の卵管摘出術または卵巣摘除術を受け、子宮摘出術を併施したものが26.5%であった。手術時間の中央値は90.0分であった。腫瘤径の中央値は6.4cmで、17.9%(n=60)は10cmを超えていた。腫瘤は単純性(11.4%)と複雑性(69.5%)に分類された。大多数(87.4%)の腫瘤は良性であったが、7.4%は悪性、5.2%は境界悪性であった。良性腫瘤は、生理的変化(16.6%)、漿液性嚢胞腺腫(19.1%)、粘液性嚢胞腺腫(6.8%)、子宮内膜症性嚢胞(12.3%)、筋腫(12.3%)、成熟奇形腫(9.2%)であった。悪性例(7.4%)では、漿液性癌が最も多い組織型(58.3%)であった。術後30日以内の有害事象の発生率は低く、再手術(0.0%)、術中損傷(1.5%)、静脈血栓塞栓症(0.3%)、輸血(0.6%)であった。創部蜂窩織炎の発生率は4.6%であった。創部ヘルニアの発生率は4.0%で、発生の中央値は18.3か月であった。糖尿病(p=.03)と肥満(p=.04)はヘルニアの有意な予測因子であったが、腫瘤の複雑性(p=.28)、ASA分類(p=.83)、喫煙(p=.82)は有意でなかった。結論:婦人科腫瘍診療においてSPLによる付属器腫瘤摘出術を受けた患者では、良性疾患の割合が高い。付属器腫瘤のSPL摘出は実施可能かつ安全であり、良好な手術成績、まれな短期有害事象、低い創部ヘルニア率を示した。
